deliverables: Fund builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Operate proposal review, debate, temperature checks, final voting, and funding rounds through the DAO process.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of KPI dashboards, including movement toward live on-chain Cardano data tracking.
Use an independent administrator/multisig to validate milestone completion before Cardano Builder DAO receives funds.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal funds initially received and administered by an independent dRep DAO council/multisig before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Create or continue the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders aligned with Vision 2030 metrics.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs such as monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Funded projects are required to track core KPIs: monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, an 83% participation rate, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a transparent smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved an 88% participation rate among members.

Official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions and KPI tracking tied to on-chain activity, users, and TVL.

An independent council composed of dRep DAO members will receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds before deployment, and oversee disbursement according to milestones in a referenced milestone and budget document.

ADA held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in separate community-auditable accounts, not delegated to any stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds, with an adastat transaction link provided.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and scale a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven builder funding mechanism, with milestone-based disbursement by an independent dRep DAO council and a stated commitment to return unused funds.
